title: Learning How to Ask Questions
credits: John Russell wrote this lesson for Learning English. Hai Do was the editor.

sentences.en: For VOA Learning English, this is the Education Report.
sentences.zh: 对于美国之音英语学习节目，这是教育报道。

sentences.en: Suzanne Meyer, the assistant director of the English Language Institute at the University of Tennessee, Knoxville, says that many students need to develop critical thinking skills.
sentences.zh: 田纳西大学诺克斯分校英语语言研究所副所长苏珊娜·迈耶表示，许多学生需要培养批判性思维技能。

sentences.en: In other words, students need to learn how to collect information, and then evaluate the information and apply it to a new context.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，学生需要学习如何收集信息，然后评估信息并将其应用于新的情境。

sentences.en: She says:
sentences.zh: 她表示：

sentences.en: "We need to get students actively engaged in inquiry, from the beginning levels on, into those levels where they really are close to professional and university contexts."
sentences.zh: "我们需要让学生从一开始的各个阶段就积极参与探究，一直到那些他们非常接近专业和大学环境的高阶段。"

sentences.en: One way to develop critical thinking skills, Meyer says, is to teach students to be creative about the types of questions that they ask.
sentences.zh: 迈耶说，培养批判性思维技能的一种方法是，教学生就他们提出的问题发挥创造性。

sentences.en: Meyer says that there are many benefits to using question-asking activities with English learners.
sentences.zh: 迈耶说，在英语学习中运用提问活动有许多好处。

sentences.en: Question-asking activities help students to become better language learners.
sentences.zh: 提问活动能帮助学生成为更好的语言学习者。

sentences.en: She says:
sentences.zh: 她表示：

sentences.en: "People who can ask questions are very confident.
sentences.zh: "会提问的人非常自信。

sentences.en: And when you are confident, you can have more interaction.
sentences.zh: 当你自信时，你就能有更多的互动。

sentences.en: That extra interaction might lead to critical thinking.
sentences.zh: 这些额外的互动可能会引发批判性思维。

sentences.en: Because you are more likely to actually integrate in some fashion into a new setting if you are in an ESL scenario.
sentences.zh: 因为如果你处于英语作为第二语言的环境中，你更有可能以某种方式真正融入一个新的环境。

sentences.en: So, I think overall, just the whole question-asking idea has so many benefits."
sentences.zh: 所以，我认为总的来说，整个提问的理念有诸多好处。"

sentences.en: There are many strategies to improve question-asking and develop critical thinking skills.
sentences.zh: 有许多策略可以提升提问能力并培养批判性思维技能。

sentences.en: One possible strategy, says Meyer, is to use question-asking patterns that start with concrete questions and move to abstract questions.
sentences.zh: 迈耶说，一种可能的策略是，运用从具体问题入手、再过渡到抽象问题的提问模式。

sentences.en: So, for example, if students were reading a new text, they would design a series of questions using three different steps.
sentences.zh: 因此，例如，如果学生正在阅读一篇新的文本，他们就会用三个不同的步骤设计一系列问题。

sentences.en: If students follow these three steps, they have not only practiced creative ways to ask questions, they have also started practicing critical thinking.
sentences.zh: 如果学生遵循这三个步骤，他们不仅练习了提问的创造性方式，还开始练习批判性思维。

sentences.en: Meyer gave an example of what this activity could look like:
sentences.zh: 迈耶举了一个活动可能呈现方式的例子：

sentences.en: In the activity, students read part of a story.
sentences.zh: 在该活动中，学生阅读故事的一部分。

sentences.en: In this case, the story is about how different foods affect a person.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，这个故事讲的是不同食物对人产生的影响。

sentences.en: These questions, and other questions listed in the table, are examples of how to develop questions.
sentences.zh: 这些问题以及表中列出的其他问题，都是如何提出问题的示例。

sentences.en: You should, of course, create your own questions!
sentences.zh: 当然，你应该提出自己的问题！

sentences.en: Meyer says that when teachers tell students which questions to answer, students are less likely to be creative about the types of questions that they ask.
sentences.zh: 迈耶指出，当老师告诉学生应该回答哪些问题，学生在提问的类型上就 less likely 更具创造性。

sentences.en: So, practice developing your own questions!
sentences.zh: 所以，多练习提出自己的问题吧！

sentences.en: Try making a list of questions that go from concrete to abstract, like the steps outlined above.
sentences.zh: 试着列出一份从具体到抽象的问题清单，就像上面概述的那些步骤。

sentences.en: Check with your teacher to make sure that your grammar is correct, and try to practice in the classroom.
sentences.zh: 与你的老师确认一下，以确保你的语法正确，并尽量在课堂上进行练习。

sentences.en: You can also write us your questions about this story in the comments section, or on our Facebook page.
sentences.zh: 你也可以在评论区或我们的Facebook页面上写下你关于这个问题的疑问。

sentences.en: Give question-asking a try, and let us know how it works for you!
sentences.zh: 试试提出问题吧，让我们知道它对你是否有效！

sentences.en: I'm John Russell.
sentences.zh: 我是约翰·拉塞尔。
